title: 第两千四百零三章 光速落实第两千四百零二章 以前的事－2
content_zh:
“过来就到你了！”谢瑜说，“太不容易了你！”
我抚掌大笑：“还没呢！”
“啊？”谢瑜问，“什么意思？家里还有人？”
“家里还有排名的，但不是人。”我说，“他家里有养狗啊，有养乌龟啊！刚才的排名人之后，还有乌龟一只，狗一只，都在他之前呀！”我边说边笑，而龙凤哥这鸟人，不但不气恼，还和我一样的笑，甚至笑得比我还大声。
“啊？！”谢瑜惊讶得我都看见她嘴里的牙齿了。
“哎，你的牙齿怎么这么整齐啊，还白！”我问，“羡慕啊！每天都刷牙两三次？那你可是牙医最痛恨的人了，永远不会成为牙医的顾客。”
“哎，凡哥，你说到我的家庭地位，说到龟，我反而有了个新想法。”龙凤哥说，“要不我们买几只不同品种的陆龟吧！要很大只的那种，放大榕树下吧！任由它们爬，如果爬到酒店大堂也好啊！人多了看着嘛！我把我家的那只租给公司咯！不用喂了，还能收租。”
“可以啊！”我说，“我怎么没有想到呢？要不这样，我和你一起出些钱，买十只八只不同品种的陆龟回来放大榕树下，租给公司嘛！哈哈！可以有。”
“现在可以这样养龟吗？”谢瑜问。
“可以啊！”龙凤哥说，“相关政策放开了啊，不过是没有完全放开而已，但已经局部放开了。凡哥，你确定吗？”
“确定啊！”我说，“不但大榕树这里放，还在大坝这里放，还有石屋区啊，树屋区啊，哦，还有巨石剧场这里，都放！反正买回来都装定位的，还有摄像头。哈哈，也是另外一个角度的度假村嘛！你去确定一下。”
“我认识养龟场的老板啊！”龙凤哥说，“天生这个老板就是吃这碗饭的。”
“怎么说？”我说，“有这样天生说法吗？我开始有点不相信你的说法了。”
“嘿，我买那只陆龟的时候，一开始我也不信啊！”龙凤哥说，“我可是亲自去养龟场挑选的！然后场长，就是老板啊，亲自给我介绍的哦，递过来名片一看，你猜人家的名字叫什么？杨贵昌！杨树的杨，贵阳贵，昌盛的昌！杨贵昌！二养龟场和杨贵昌的读法就几乎一样啊！你说人家不是天生的养龟场老板是什么？你信了吧？”
“嗯，我一直相信啊！”我转过来对谢瑜说，“你不信也得信！为什们我们叫他龙凤哥？他全名叫程翔，既然是程翔，那就是呈祥嘛！既然呈祥，前面肯定是龙凤的啦！龙凤呈祥，然后他生了一对龙凤胎，不叫龙凤哥，叫什么？”
“哈哈哈！对头！”谢瑜说，“从来我们中国人给人起外号，都是主打一个极其贴切的缘由。”
“那我还真的买了啊！”龙凤哥说，“你不出钱，我自己出钱也行。或者说找谁合股？可以？”
我说：“那买啊！从来我们都拍脑子决定的啊！不过貌似没啥损失是不是？矮仔成和小解那里，每天这么多青菜梆子，丢了可惜，喂龟。而且是要捆绑起来，一把另外卖十元八元的，可以有啊！我带我女儿是动物园，喂长颈鹿，就那么三根树枝，收15元啊！我女儿连喂三次！大门票才20元呢！”
“也行啊！”龙凤哥说，“村里我知道有两个老太太，一个是孩子出海外去了，另外一个台风时候孩子出海就再也没有回来。他俩自己种着菜，又吃不完，本来饭餐就有矮仔成那里惯着，所以他们经常在村口摆摊，也卖不完。若是我们买龟回来，顺便将她俩的菜给买下来，能吃的我们放餐厅，不好看的，喂龟，或者说就让她俩进来卖菜你说如何？”
“对呀！”我说，“可以可以！有村里老人进度假村来，也是本地历史的一种展现嘛！”

“你就不怕其他人眼红？”谢瑜问，“很容易闹矛盾。”
我安慰她：“凡事无绝对嘛！人家的情况，谁有类似的情况，可以进来啊！”我将矮仔成餐厅无偿的付出这事说了一下，顺便也将温泉水井煮温泉蛋这事是如何安排的也说了一遍后，谢瑜朝我俩竖起了大拇指：
“行啊你！还真的小时候是怎样的人心，长大了也不会变。”
“谢谢，谢谢！我…”我还没有说完，就给龙凤哥给打断了：
“他遭到了表扬！哈哈！”
“这啥事啊？什么风格？”眼镜女忍不住了，凑了过来，“表扬不是得到的吗？怎么是遭到了表扬呢？”
“哎呀，一听就知道是他们这个团队，哦是这个团伙的风格啦！”谢瑜笑了出来，“我们努力靠近一下。”
我连连摆手：“哎，大姐，你们是银行呀！不能像我们这样无组织无纪律呀！你们得任何时候都端着，哦，不是端着，是任何时候都要给人一种稳重的感觉呀！我们不同，我们任何时候都是度假风，和你们的态度要截然相反。不然，那个客人会花3000元来感受工作风的度假呢？傻子都不会啦！”
这边刚说完，那边龙凤哥就给杨贵昌打了电话，还是免提：“喂，杨场长啊！我，哦，一看电话号码就知道我谁了？你厉害！我们度假村想买十来只大型的陆地龟哦！放度假村里自由生长啊！最好就是类似孤独的乔治那种也有就最好了。哦，那种不敢有？哈哈哈，我说着玩呢！爱，但是我们买龟这事不是玩哦！具体多少只来着，我也不敢说，你能来一趟不？我们就主要是放在露天给客人看看，可能也会喂喂它们咯！一个区域够大的话，放三五只也行？好好好！你明天来是吧？ok！我发定位给你。好的，就这样。”
谢瑜看了：“这就是效率呀！你我们还快！”
我说：“拖拖拉拉没意思啊！速战速决。对了，龙凤哥，你当时你买那只多少钱来着？我看看找谁一起投资。”
content_en:
"It's your turn!" Xie Yu said, "It's not easy for you!"
I put my hands on my hands and laughed: "Not yet!"
"Ah?" Xie Yu asked, "What do you mean? Is there anyone else at home?"
"There are some ranked people at home, but they are not people." I said, "He has dogs and turtles at home! After the ranked person just now, there is a tortoise and a dog, both before him!" I laughed while talking, but not only was Brother Longfeng not angry, he laughed like me, and even laughed louder than me.
"Ah?!" Xie Yu was so surprised that I even saw the teeth in her mouth.
"Hey, why are your teeth so neat and white?" I asked, "I'm so envious! You brush your teeth two or three times a day? Then you are the person that the dentist hates the most, and you will never become a customer of the dentist."
"Hey, Brother Fan, when you talk about my family status, when it comes to turtles, I have a new idea." Brother Longfeng said, "How about we buy a few tortoises of different species! If you want a big one, put it under the banyan tree! Let them crawl, even if they climb to the hotel lobby! There are more people to watch! I rented the one I own to the company! I don't need to feed it, and I can still collect rent."
"Sure!" I said, "Why didn't I think of that? Otherwise, I'll spend some money with you to buy ten or eight different species of tortoises, put them under the banyan tree, and rent them to the company! Haha! You can have them."
"Is it possible to raise turtles like this now?" Xie Yu asked.
"Yes!" Brother Longfeng said, "Relevant policies have been liberalized, but they have not been completely liberalized, but they have been partially liberalized. Brother Fan, are you sure?"
"Sure!" I said, "Not only are they placed here under the big banyan tree, but they are also placed here at the dam. There are also stone house areas, tree house areas, and, oh, there are also the boulder theater. They are all placed! After all, they are equipped with positioning and cameras after buying them. Haha, it is also a resort from another angle! You go and confirm it."
"I know the boss of the turtle farm!" Brother Longfeng said, "This boss is born to eat this bowl of rice."
"How do you say it?" I said, "Is there such a natural way of saying it? I'm starting to not believe what you said."
"Hey, when I bought that tortoise, I didn't believe it at first!" Brother Longfeng said, "I went to the turtle farm to select it myself! Then the director of the farm, the boss, introduced it to me personally. He handed me his business card and took a look. Guess What's his name? Yang Guichang, Guiyang Guichang! The pronunciation of the second turtle farm is almost the same! Do you believe that he is not a natural turtle farm owner?
"Well, I have always believed it!" I turned to Xie Yu and said, "You have to believe it even if you don't believe it! Why do we call him Brother Longfeng? His full name is Cheng Xiang. Since it is Cheng Xiang, it is Chengxiang! Since it is Chengxiang, it must be the dragon and phoenix in front! The dragon and phoenix present Xiang, and then he gave birth to a pair of dragon and phoenix twins. If not called Dragon and Phoenix brother, what would they be called?"
"Hahaha! Enemy!" Xie Yu said, "We Chinese have always given nicknames to people for a very appropriate reason."
"Then I really bought it!" Brother Longfeng said, "If you don't pay for it, I can pay for it myself. Or should I find someone to form a joint stock? Okay?"
I said, "Let's buy it! We always make the decision with our brains! But it seems like there is no loss, right? There are so many green vegetable clappers in Chenghe Xiaojie's place every day. It's a pity to throw them away to feed the turtles. And they have to be tied up, and they sell for 10 yuan or 8 yuan each. You can have them! I took my daughter to the zoo to feed the giraffes, just three branches, and charged 15 yuan! My daughter was fed three times in a row! The big ticket is only 20 yuan!"
"That's okay!" Brother Longfeng said, "I know there are two old ladies in the village. One has a child who went overseas, and the other's child went overseas during the typhoon and never came back. They grew vegetables by themselves and couldn't finish the food.Originally, there were short boys who took care of the food, so they often set up stalls at the entrance of the village, but they couldn't sell out all the food. If we come back from buying turtles, we can also buy their vegetables. We can put the edible ones in the restaurant, and feed the turtles if they are not good-looking. Or what do you think, let them come in and sell vegetables? "
"Yes! ” I said, “Okay, okay!” Having old people from the village come into the resort is also a display of local history! "
"Aren't you afraid that other people will be jealous? Xie Yu asked, "It's easy to have conflicts." "
I comforted her: "There are no absolutes in everything! If anyone has a similar situation, you can come in! "After I explained the free contribution of Aizai Cheng to the restaurant, and how the hot spring eggs were cooked in the hot spring well, Xie Yu gave us a thumbs up:
"Okay you! It’s true that the kind of heart you had when you were a child will not change when you grow up. "
"Thank you, thank you! I..." Before I could finish speaking, I was interrupted by Brother Longfeng:
“He was praised! Ha ha! "
"What's this? What style? "The girl with glasses couldn't help it anymore and came closer, "Don't you deserve praise? Why was he praised? "
“Oh, I knew it was their team as soon as I heard it, it’s the style of this gang! Xie Yu laughed and said, "Let's try to get closer." "
I waved my hands repeatedly: "Hey, eldest sister, you are a bank! We can't be as unorganized and undisciplined as we are! You have to hold it up at all times, oh, not hold it up, but give people a sense of stability at all times! We are different. We always have a vacation style, which is completely opposite to your attitude. Otherwise, which guest would spend 3,000 yuan to experience a work-style vacation? No fool can do it! "
As soon as he finished speaking, Brother Longfeng called Yang Guichang, still on the phone: "Hey, Director Yang! I, oh, you know who I am just by looking at my phone number? You are awesome! Our resort wants to buy a dozen large land turtles! Let it grow freely in the resort! It would be best to have something similar to Lonely George. Oh, that kind of thing you dare not have? Hahaha, I was just joking! Love it, but buying a turtle is not just for fun! I don’t dare to say how many are here specifically. Can you come? We mainly put it in the open air for guests to see, and maybe feed them too! If an area is big enough, is it okay to put three or five? OK OK! You're coming tomorrow, right? OK! I'll send you the location. Okay, that's it. "
Xie Yu looked at it: "This is efficiency! You and we are faster! "
I said: "It's boring to procrastinate! Quick victory. By the way, Brother Longfeng, how much did you pay for that one? I'll see who I can invest with. "
